mapper.insert: INSERT INTO upload_record (user_id, file_name, file_type, file_size, file_path, status, question_count, upload_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{filePath}, #{status}, #{questionCount}, #{uploadDate})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upload_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND upload_date = #{uploadDate}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upload_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
